verdict.rationale: Highnote documents the Card Viewer SDK which embeds PAN/CVV via iframes so sensitive data never touches subscriber servers or scripts, explicitly to prevent PCI-scoped data exposure, and separately advises using SDKs to reduce PCI compliance requirements (implying reduced scope vs. direct server access). missing for 10: explicit statement referencing SAQ D by name or an independent PCI audit/attestation confirming scope reduction.
